history: RJ 州的客户一共支付了多少钱？
question: 那 SP 州呢？
goldSql: SELECT SUM(pay.payment_value) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_payments pay ON o.order_id = pay.order_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'

history: 每种支付方式的支付总金额分别是多少？
question: 只看 SP 州的客户呢？
goldSql: SELECT pay.payment_type, SUM(pay.payment_value) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_payments pay ON o.order_id = pay.order_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP' GROUP BY pay.payment_type

history: 卖出商品件数最多的前 5 个商品类别是哪些？用英文类别名回答。
question: 前 3 个呢？
goldSql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: 2017 年呢？

history: SP 州的卖家一共卖出了多少件商品？
question: 按商品类别看，哪个类别卖得最多？用英文类别名回答。
goldSql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP' GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
